summary: Added sdk/simulation: SimulatedClock, SimulatedGame (collections, daily reward once per day, mineral-priced room upgrades returning a raw response, gas-priced research, training unmodelled, seeded trophy changes; day-boundary completion), load_scenario, run_scenario and ScenarioResult with progression, fleet and audit JSON, plus scenarios single-account (3 days, 800-mineral budget) and two-accounts (bravo budget blocks upgrades). 7 tests in tests/test_simulation.py: determinism per scenario, seed sensitivity, budget adherence, isolation with a clean audit, attempt-id renumbering, and a socket-blocked run. Documented in docs/baseline/simulation.md.

contract_status_changes.before: No end-to-end offline scenario exercised registry, orchestrator, runner, journals and reports together
contract_status_changes.after: Seeded scenarios run the full stack offline and reproduce byte-identical reports

residual_risks: The simulated game's economics are illustrative, not calibrated to the live game.
